courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道防水膜鋪設
related.transfer: 可遷移「掌子面擠出與地層核心」與「施工時間與黏結成熟」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道防水膜鋪設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Face extrusion and ground core" and "Construction time and bond maturity" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強；隧道防水膜鋪設則以以水壓邊界、焊縫與分區連續性驗證隧道防水膜為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length; Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation centres on verify tunnel membranes through pressure boundaries, seams and compartment continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掌子面擠出與地層核心」與「水頭與結構承壓邊界」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道防水膜鋪設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「穿透構件與接縫變形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Face extrusion and ground core” and “Head and structural pressure boundary”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Penetrations and joint movement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿
history.text: 本課討論的以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
